titulo.alumno: A text with several voices · Integrated reading B1

intro: Part 3: a text with several voices. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: In an integrated reading, first define what the question asks. For a fact, look for explicit evidence; for an inference, combine clues and discard conclusions the text does not support.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.estudio: Artiklen gengiver både kommunens svar og naboernes kritik.
frases.alumno: The article reproduces both the council's answer and the neighbours' criticism.

frases.estudio: Den viser, at parterne er enige om problemet, men ikke om løsningen.
frases.alumno: It shows that the parties agree on the problem, but not on the solution.
